War Drummer

You know how to make frightened feet move together.

Whose pace do you still hear beneath the beat?

Rules

Choose one:

- Influence 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.72c9b5b537fad77d.JournalEntryPage.e91be48a8e1daf06]{Keep Time with Steel}. - Guard 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.f90d324afc1f7997.JournalEntryPage.0a730e9328c623f4]{Shielding Step}.

Type: Background

Each option is a pair. Duplicate grants give 1 level-0 DP each; no automatic higher rank. Follow the card’s equipment grant.

Starting coin contribution: +7 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
